themes.sign_ranking: Ranks or singles out zodiac signs (the sign that never..., the most loyal, the smartest)
themes.love_compatibility: Couples, compatibility, exes, cheating or who suits whom
themes.sign_portrait: Personality portrait of one sign or a birth date
themes.forecast: Horoscope or prediction for a period (week, month, year, event)
themes.quiz_game: Quiz or game asking viewers to guess, choose or comment their sign
themes.other: Anything else or not enough information

formats.presenter_talk: A presenter (real or AI) speaks to camera
formats.voiceover_montage: Voice-over on images, symbols or stock footage without a visible presenter
formats.text_list: On-screen text or list carries the content, little or no voice
formats.other: Anything else or not enough information

hooks.sign_callout: Names one or more signs in the first seconds so viewers of that sign feel targeted
hooks.provocative_claim: Opens with a bold or negative claim about a sign (never, worst, toxic)
hooks.presenter_eye_contact: A presenter looks into the camera and addresses the viewer in the first seconds
hooks.quiz_question: Opens with a question or challenge asking viewers to guess or answer
hooks.birthdate_prompt: Asks for or shows a birth date, month or sign to comment
hooks.no_hook: Static title, logo or slow build with no clear hook
